phase: Created-At Multi-Dimension Acquisition Cost Per Outcome Snapshot
objective: Resolve one canonical CRM created-at relationship cohort and delegate that exact cohort once to the multi-dimension acquisition cost-per-outcome snapshot application.

readPlan.costPerOutcomeSnapshot: one getSnapshot call over the exact resolved cohort

rules: CRM remains sole owner of created-at timestamp validation, lower-inclusive upper-exclusive boundaries, ordering, default limit, and limit validation.
The created-at relationship cohort is read exactly once.
Returned CRM relationship IDs are canonically validated before snapshot delegation.
The exact resolved relationship ID array is supplied to INS-004H once.
Requested dimensions are passed through unchanged; INS-004H owns dimension validation and deduplication.
Omitted limit remains omitted when constructing the CRM cohort query.
This represents lifetime-to-date durable quote and bind attainment, and corresponding acquisition cost per outcome, for relationships created inside the requested date window.
Outcome occurredAt is not filtered by the created-at window.
Acquisition economics facts are not independently time-windowed by this composition layer.

INS-004H remains sole owner of attributed-economics and durable-outcome reads, dimension projection, currency isolation, exact numeratorMinorUnits/denominatorCount semantics, and zero-denominator omission.
No new SQL, date parsing, date rewriting, persistence mutation, arithmetic division, percentage formatting, rounding, status inference, or currency conversion is introduced.
